subject: Logic
title: Survivorship Bias
description: A fast breakdown of Survivorship Bias for builders.

hook.text: "Follow your passion—look at these successful founders!" What about the thousands who followed and failed?

buildup.text: Survivorship bias studies the winners and ignores the losers, distorting the true picture.

discovery.text: WWII planes returned with bullet holes on wings. Engineers wanted to armor those spots—wrong move.

twist.text: Abraham Wald realized: armor where there AREN'T holes—those planes didn't survive to be studied.

climax.text: To avoid survivorship bias, always ask: where are the failures? What does the data not show me?

punchline.text: The dead tell no tales—but they should.
